status.refreshing: “{{name}}” does not answer: updating its subscription
status.waiting: No server answered. Trying again after a pause (round {{round}} of {{rounds}})
status.gaveUp: No server answered in {{rounds}} rounds. Connect by hand or pick another server

exposure.direct: Traffic goes out directly, without the VPN
exposure.blocked: The kill switch holds traffic until the connection is back
exposure.proxyBlocked: Programs that use the system proxy wait; the others go out directly
exposure.tunnel: Traffic stays inside the VPN connection
exposure.proxyTunnel: Programs that use the system proxy stay inside the VPN connection; the others go out directly
exposure.unknown: Whether traffic is held is not checked

launch.failed: Could not connect at start to “{{name}}”

rescue.gaveUp: No server answered. Nothing more is tried until you connect or the network changes
